finalText:
Migrated all 12 files still on `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`: `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, and `session.js`.

One spot is left on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It's a vendored file, and its own comment says local edits get wiped on every upgrade. Changing it would just be lost, so it needs a fix upstream instead.
